objective_value: <float> Makespan of the proposed schedule: the largest completion time over all jobs (max over jobs of completion_time). Must equal the recomputed makespan.

schedule.job_id: <int> Identifier of the job, matching jobs[].job_id in the instance (each job appears exactly once).
schedule.completion_time: <float> Time the job's last operation finishes; must equal start_time of its last scheduled operation plus that operation's processing_time.

operations.machine: <int> Machine this scheduled operation runs on, matching the instance operation at the same position in the job's sequence.
operations.start_time: <float> Time (>= 0) at which this operation starts on its machine.
